title: Spillover-Aware Multi-Value Steering for Pluralistic LLM Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.05800v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering controls LLM behavior at inference time by adding learned directions to hidden states, but existing methods handle one concept at a time. Pluralistic alignment, where different stakeholders need different value emphases, requires steering multiple dimensions simultaneously. We show that naive steering produces substantial spillover: the effect intended for one value leaks into others. This parallels the treatment-versus-spillover decomposition in causal inference. We trace spillover to geometric entanglement of steering directions, captured by their Gram matrix, and derive a zero-cost correction from an activation-norm-penalized objective that decouples each direction's contribution exactly. Our end-to-end pipeline requires no fine-tuning, no reward model, and no manual prompt engineering: given only domain questions, it automatically discovers value dimensions, extracts directions, diagnoses entanglement, and applies

translated_title: 面向大语言模型多元化对齐的溢出感知多价值引导方法
translated_abstract: 激活引导（Activation Steering）通过向隐藏状态添加学习到的方向来在推理时控制大语言模型的行为，但现有方法一次只能处理一个概念。多元化对齐（Pluralistic Alignment）场景下，不同的利益相关者需要不同的价值侧重，因此需要同时引导多个维度。我们证明朴素的多值引导会产生显著的溢出效应：针对某一价值施加的影响会泄漏到其他价值中。这一现象与因果推断中的“处理效应与溢出效应”分解相类似。我们将溢出效应归因于引导方向之间的几何纠缠，并可通过其格拉姆矩阵（Gram Matrix）加以刻画，进而从带激活范数惩罚的目标函数中推导出一种零成本修正方法，能够精确解耦每个方向的贡献。我们的端到端流水线无需微调、无需奖励模型、也无需人工提示工程：仅需给定领域问题，即可自动发现价值维度、提取引导方向、诊断方向纠缠并应用修正。
tldr: 提出了一种溢出感知的多价值引导方法，通过格拉姆矩阵诊断引导方向间的几何纠缠，并利用基于激活范数惩罚目标的零成本修正精确解耦各方向的贡献，在无需微调、奖励模型和人工提示工程的情况下实现大语言模型的多元化对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spillover-aware multi-value steering method that diagnoses geometric entanglement of steering directions via their Gram matrix and derives a zero-cost correction from an activation-norm-penalized objective to exactly decouple each direction's contribution, enabling pluralistic LLM alignment without fine-tuning, reward models, or manual prompt engineering.
